notes: robots.txt open; the news sitemaps (donga-newsmap.xml) hold only 2 days, but the 30-year archive index https://image.donga.com/sitemap/donga-sitemap.xml lists .gz sitemaps of TWO calendar months each in fixed pairs (Jan-Feb, Mar-Apr, May-Jun, Jul-Aug, Sep-Oct, Nov-Dec, refreshed daily 09:00 KST), so the Sep-Oct file holds our whole window (2026-09-01..10-25 now); lastmod is the KST publication date and the date is also inside each URL (/article/all/YYYYMMDD/<id>/<n>), lastmod==date gives 34-518 URLs on every day 2026-09-25..10-25 (518/147/448 on 09-30/10-10/10-20); no per-day sitemap or dated HTML archive exists (donga-newsmap-*.xml and news/List?day= are soft-200 empty/JS pages that ignore the date).
